measures.title: Commission on Aging Millage Renewal
measures.summary: Would renew Montcalm County's property tax of 0.45 mill ($0.45 per $1,000 of taxable value) for four years, 2027 through 2030, to fund the Montcalm County Commission on Aging for senior citizen services. The first-year levy is estimated to raise $1,346,510.71. Part of the millage may be captured by downtown development authorities in Edmore, Crystal Township, Howard City, Lakeview and Greenville.
measures.yesMeans: Montcalm County would continue the 0.45 mill Commission on Aging tax for 2027 through 2030.
measures.noMeans: The Commission on Aging millage would not be renewed.
